GOV-F-003-S65.title: Lock Schema and Ownership Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S65.description: Define and enforce the Brain lock schema including fields for lock_id, resource_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at, and status. Ensure consistent contract across Brain services and Mongo persistence with validation rules.

GOV-F-003-S66.title: Atomic Lock Acquisition with TTL Enforcement
GOV-F-003-S66.description: Implement atomic lock acquisition logic using MongoDB operations to ensure single-owner access. Enforce TTL at write time and prevent acquisition if a valid lock exists unless expired.

GOV-F-003-S67.title: Lock Management API for Brain Services
GOV-F-003-S67.description: Expose internal APIs for lock acquire, renew, release, and status check to be used by brain_runner and brain_loop. Ensure consistent error handling and ownership validation across all entry points.

GOV-F-003-S68.title: Lock Integration with Assignment Execution Flow
GOV-F-003-S68.description: Integrate lock acquisition and release into assignment lifecycle within brain_runner to ensure each assignment is executed exactly once. Include safeguards for partial execution and retry scenarios.
